notes.title: HARD MODE!!...and more...?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505105/28465ab32b96a8d6431591b6dd401b3be3ddd68e.png[/img]

Thank you so much for playing MYRIAD DEATH.
We are excited to announce that the Hard Mode will be added to the game soon.
You can play it once you finish the normal storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505105/deac83a48315c161658feb9d6464dbe63aafd7b1.gif[/img]

In the Hard Mode, you can play with higher difficulty that includes the below changes.

- Increased number, strength, and speed of enemies
- Greater HP, strength, speed, and resistance for bosses
- Decreased drop rates for items

Especially the drop rates of recovery items will significantly change for the Hard Mode. 
Players would be required to not only use Melee and Ranged weapons more wisely but also be careful of the timings of using recovery potions and bombs.

Please enjoy the tougher underworld.

Regarding the details of Version 1.2.0, we will update another article once the game is updated.
Thank you for your continuous support.

tags.feature: We are excited to announce that the Hard Mode will be added to the game soon.

tags.balance_change: - Increased number, strength, and speed of enemies
- Greater HP, strength, speed, and resistance for bosses

notes.title: Announcement of Patch Release(Ver.1.0.3)
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing Myriad Death.
We have released a new patch Ver.1.0.3 which includes the below bug fix.

[b]Details[/b]

- Fixed the volume setting of the credit roll to be the same volume in the settings. 
- Game balance adjustment.
- Added destroyable objects.
- Made minor fix.

Regarding the part of the enemy's strength, 
we decided to make them a bit stronger since we have noticed players are way stronger than we expected.
We have adjusted the HP and resistance to the status effect of some bosses, as well as normal enemies along the way.
We hope that players who have beaten the game will challenge the game again with the updated difficulty levels.

We will continue to make adjustments based on users' feedback.
If you have any requests, please send them to the "Opinions and Requests" thread.

Lastly, we are super happy that so many of you are playing our game.
Thank you for your continued support.

tags.bug: - Fixed the volume setting of the credit roll to be the same volume in the settings.
